Title: NETMESSAGE:You can break this door with explosives.
Translation: 你可以用炸药炸开这扇门。

Title: NETMESSAGE:This door is reinforced and apparently the explosives cant break it.
Translation: 这扇门被加固了，显然炸药无法炸开它。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Apparently the rescue team didn't make it...
NETMESSAGE:It seems the helicopter has arrived. Let's follow the soldier on the other side.
Translation: 看来直升机已经到达了。我们跟着那边的士兵走。

Title: NETMESSAGE:A horde of zombies is coming from the way we came...
Translation: 一大群僵尸正从我们来时的路涌来……
